c74object.name: evi_polyblep_utility
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_polyblep_utility.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_polyblep_utility.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
This file is not very interesting on it's own and simply contains code found elsewhere in the evieve Package. It is for making the evieve polyblep requires more manageable when building gen~ or MSP abstractions.

entry.name: cos73 ( )
entry.description:
Cosine approximation to 7.3 digits of accuracy
In 1: type=input: x, Phase 0..TWOPI
Return 1: Cos, Cosine oscillator

entry.name: sin73 ( )
entry.description:
Sine approximation to 7.3 digits of accuracy
In 1: type=input: x, Phase 0..TWOPI
Return 1: Sin, Sine oscillator

entry.name: varDcblockReset ( )
entry.description:
Variable dcblock() so that effect can be bypassed (a0 = 1) or active (a0 = 0.9997) or heavy (a0 = ...), with state reset inlet
In 1: type=input: x0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a0, Dc coefficient, typically 0.9997 for basic dcblock()
In 3: type=input: r0, Sample accurate filter state reset inlet
Return 1: Audio output, Variable dc blocked audio output

entry.name: dynamicDc ( )
entry.description:
Dynamically vary dcblocking and gain so that oscillators can frequency dependent morph between LFOs and audio rate osciallators. Note, this is extremely suspicious code.
In 1: type=input: osc, Oscillator input
In 2: type=input: dtn, clip((phase_increment*2), 0, 1)
In 3: type=input: dcn, (int) switch state, 0=dcblock off, 1=dcblock on, 2=var dc good for low oscs, 3=var dc good for high oscs
Return 1: Osc, Oscillator output

entry.name: decorelateOsc ( )
entry.description:
Post-filter to decolorate (oscillator) waveshapers when (polyblep) antialiasing is used, Stefano D'Angelo, GPL v3
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
Return 1: Audio output, Decorrelated audio output
